ex.en: An undertaker arrived at the house early in the morning.
ex.zh: 一位葬儀社人員一大早就到了那棟房子。

ex.en: I'm still undecided about which university to choose.
ex.zh: 我還沒決定要選哪一所大學。

ex.en: Many voters remain undecided a week before the election.
ex.zh: 選舉前一週，許多選民仍未決定。

ex.en: Workers unearthed old coins while digging the garden.
ex.zh: 工人在挖花園時挖出了舊硬幣。

ex.en: Reporters unearthed new facts about the company.
ex.zh: 記者挖掘出關於這家公司的新事實。

ex.en: Unionism grew quickly among factory workers.
ex.zh: 工會主義在工廠工人之間迅速發展。

ex.en: The professor wrote a book on the history of unionism.
ex.zh: 這位教授寫了一本關於工會主義歷史的書。

ex.en: I felt unprepared for the final exam.
ex.zh: 我覺得自己還沒準備好應付期末考。

ex.en: The sudden storm caught us unprepared.
ex.zh: 突如其來的暴風雨讓我們措手不及。

ex.en: She gave an unprepared speech that impressed everyone.
ex.zh: 她發表了一場即席演講，令大家印象深刻。

ex.en: His unprepared answer was surprisingly good.
ex.zh: 他未經準備的回答出奇地好。

ex.en: There was an uncanny silence in the empty house.
ex.zh: 空屋裡有一種詭異的寂靜。

ex.en: She has an uncanny ability to guess what I am thinking.
ex.zh: 她有種驚人的本事能猜到我在想什麼。

ex.en: The unnamed source asked not to be identified in the article.
ex.zh: 這位不具名的消息來源要求不要在文章中被公開身分。

ex.en: We walked along an unnamed street behind the old market.
ex.zh: 我們沿著舊市場後面一條沒有名字的街走。

ex.en: The plan is unattractive to most investors.
ex.zh: 這個計畫對大多數投資人沒有吸引力。

ex.en: They painted over the unattractive gray walls.
ex.zh: 他們把難看的灰色牆壁重新粉刷。

ex.en: The rumor about the school closing is completely untrue.
ex.zh: 學校要關閉的傳言完全不實。

ex.en: It would be untrue to say that I enjoyed the movie.
ex.zh: 如果說我喜歡那部電影，那就不是實話。

ex.en: Spread the paint uniformly over the wall.
ex.zh: 把油漆均勻地塗在牆上。

ex.en: The reviews of the book were uniformly positive.
ex.zh: 這本書的評價一致都是正面的。

ex.en: Miraculously, the glass landed unbroken on the floor.
ex.zh: 奇蹟似地，那個玻璃杯掉到地上卻完好無損。

ex.en: The seal on the bottle was still unbroken.
ex.zh: 瓶子上的封條還沒被撕破。

ex.en: She slept eight hours of unbroken sleep.
ex.zh: 她連續睡了八個小時沒被吵醒。

ex.en: The team has an unbroken record of wins this season.
ex.zh: 球隊本季保持著連勝的紀錄。

ex.en: He unwittingly revealed the secret during dinner.
ex.zh: 他在晚餐時不經意地洩露了祕密。

ex.en: The company had unwittingly hired a thief.
ex.zh: 公司在不知情的情況下僱用了一名小偷。

ex.en: The uncontrolled fire spread quickly through the forest.
ex.zh: 失控的大火迅速蔓延過整片森林。

ex.en: He burst into uncontrolled laughter during the speech.
ex.zh: 演講時他忍不住爆出一陣失控的大笑。

ex.en: She is an undoubted leader in her field.
ex.zh: 她無庸置疑是自己領域的領導者。

ex.en: The team's undoubted talent earned them the title.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍毋庸置疑的實力為他們贏得了冠軍。

ex.en: The baby slept undisturbed through the storm.
ex.zh: 寶寶在暴風雨中睡得安穩不受打擾。

ex.en: The forest has remained undisturbed for hundreds of years.
ex.zh: 這片森林數百年來未受人為干擾。

ex.en: Many undocumented workers fear being sent home.
ex.zh: 許多沒有合法證件的工人害怕被遣返。

ex.en: The law affects undocumented immigrants living in the city.
ex.zh: 這項法律影響住在這座城市的無證移民。

ex.en: The software has many undocumented features.
ex.zh: 這套軟體有許多沒有文件說明的功能。

ex.en: Historians found an undocumented trade route.
ex.zh: 歷史學家發現了一條沒有文獻記載的貿易路線。

ex.en: The minister gave an unequivocal answer: no.
ex.zh: 部長給了明確的答覆：不行。

ex.en: There is unequivocal evidence that exercise helps your heart.
ex.zh: 有明確的證據顯示運動對心臟有益。

unpack.zh: 打開行李；把東西拿出來

ex.en: We unpacked our suitcases as soon as we reached the hotel.
ex.zh: 一到飯店我們就把行李箱整理好。

ex.en: Can you help me unpack these boxes?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我拆開這些箱子嗎？

ex.en: The teacher took time to unpack the difficult poem.
ex.zh: 老師花時間把那首艱深的詩逐句解析。

ex.en: Let's unpack what this sentence really means.
ex.zh: 我們來把這句話的真正意思說清楚。

unhelpful.zh: 沒有幫助的；不肯幫忙的

ex.en: The clerk was rude and unhelpful.
ex.zh: 那位店員態度無禮又不肯幫忙。

ex.en: I found the instructions confusing and unhelpful.
ex.zh: 我覺得這份說明書又亂又沒用。

ex.en: She sang quietly to her unborn baby.
ex.zh: 她對著肚子裡還沒出生的寶寶輕聲唱歌。

ex.en: Doctors take care to protect the unborn child.
ex.zh: 醫生會特別留意保護胎兒。

ex.en: The coach had an uncompromising attitude toward cheating.
ex.zh: 教練對作弊抱持毫不妥協的態度。

ex.en: She is uncompromising about the quality of her work.
ex.zh: 她對自己工作的品質絕不讓步。

ex.en: He was unqualified for the job.
ex.zh: 他不具備擔任這份工作的資格。

ex.en: An unqualified person should not give medical advice.
ex.zh: 沒有資格的人不應該給醫療建議。

ex.en: The party was an unqualified success.
ex.zh: 這場派對是徹頭徹尾的成功。

ex.en: She gave the plan her unqualified support.
ex.zh: 她對這項計畫給予毫無保留的支持。

ex.en: Her unhappiness was obvious to everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 她的不快樂，房間裡每個人都看得出來。

ex.en: Money alone cannot cure the unhappiness he feels at work.
ex.zh: 光靠金錢無法消除他在工作中感到的不快樂。

ex.en: It was unkind of him to laugh at her mistake.
ex.zh: 他嘲笑她的錯誤真不厚道。

ex.en: She regretted the unkind words she said to her friend.
ex.zh: 她後悔對朋友說了刻薄的話。

unheard.zh: 沒被聽見的；未被理會的

ex.en: Her cries for help went unheard in the noisy street.
ex.zh: 她的求救聲在吵雜的街上沒被聽見。

ex.en: Many workers feel their opinions go unheard.
ex.zh: 許多員工覺得自己的意見沒人理會。

ex.en: His unwillingness to help surprised everyone.
ex.zh: 他不願幫忙讓大家很意外。

ex.en: The manager noticed the team's unwillingness to change.
ex.zh: 經理注意到團隊不願意改變。

ex.en: The police found an unmarked car outside the house.
ex.zh: 警方在房子外發現一輛沒有標誌的車。

ex.en: The package was unmarked, so nobody knew who sent it.
ex.zh: 包裹上沒有任何標記，所以沒人知道是誰寄的。

ex.en: Her kindness went unmarked by most of her coworkers.
ex.zh: 她的善意沒有被多數同事注意到。

ex.en: The small mistake passed unmarked in the busy meeting.
ex.zh: 忙碌的會議中，這個小錯誤沒被人發現。

ex.en: The village was left unprotected during the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水期間村莊沒有任何防護。

ex.en: Don't leave your skin unprotected in the strong sun.
ex.zh: 別讓皮膚在強烈陽光下沒有防曬。

ex.en: The teacher calmed the unruly class.
ex.zh: 老師安撫了吵鬧難管的班級。

ex.en: She tried to brush her unruly hair.
ex.zh: 她試著梳理那頭不聽話的頭髮。

ex.en: The uniqueness of each snowflake amazes children.
ex.zh: 每片雪花的獨特性讓孩子們驚奇。

ex.en: We value the uniqueness of every student.
ex.zh: 我們重視每位學生的獨特性。

ex.en: The unfavourable weather forced us to cancel the picnic.
ex.zh: 不利的天氣迫使我們取消野餐。

ex.en: The film received unfavourable reviews from critics.
ex.zh: 這部電影受到影評人的負面評價。

ex.en: It is undeniable that exercise improves your health.
ex.zh: 運動能改善健康是不可否認的。

ex.en: She has an undeniable talent for singing.
ex.zh: 她在唱歌方面有不可否認的天分。

ex.en: The sign gave an unambiguous warning about the danger.
ex.zh: 這個標示對危險給出了明確的警告。

ex.en: Please write unambiguous instructions that anyone can follow.
ex.zh: 請寫出任何人都能遵循的明確說明。

ex.en: The boss was unreasonably angry about a small mistake.
ex.zh: 老闆為了一個小錯誤而過分生氣。

ex.en: The price of the ticket is unreasonably high.
ex.zh: 這張票的價格高得不合理。

ex.en: The pain of losing a child is unimaginable.
ex.zh: 失去孩子的痛苦是無法想像的。

ex.en: Ten years ago, such technology was unimaginable.
ex.zh: 十年前，這樣的科技還無法想像。

ex.en: The strange noise in the dark house began to unnerve me.
ex.zh: 黑暗屋子裡的怪聲開始讓我心神不寧。

ex.en: Don't let the big crowd unnerve you during your speech.
ex.zh: 演講時別讓人群嚇到你。

ex.en: The doctor asked him to undress and put on a gown.
ex.zh: 醫生請他脫掉衣服換上病人袍。

ex.en: The little boy was able to undress himself before bath time.
ex.zh: 小男孩在洗澡前自己就能脫衣服。

ex.en: Untreated infections can become very serious.
ex.zh: 沒有治療的感染可能變得非常嚴重。

ex.en: He left his illness untreated for months.
ex.zh: 他的病拖了好幾個月都沒治療。

ex.en: Untreated wood will rot quickly outdoors.
ex.zh: 未經處理的木材放在戶外很快就會腐爛。

ex.en: The factory dumped untreated water into the river.
ex.zh: 工廠把未經處理的廢水排入河裡。

ex.en: Unauthorised persons are not allowed to enter this room.
ex.zh: 未經授權的人員不得進入這個房間。

ex.en: The company banned the unauthorised use of its logo.
ex.zh: 公司禁止未經授權使用它的標誌。

ex.en: I prefer unsalted butter when I bake cakes.
ex.zh: 烤蛋糕時我偏好用無鹽奶油。

ex.en: These unsalted nuts are a healthy snack.
ex.zh: 這些無鹽堅果是健康的點心。

ex.en: The soup tasted bland because the stock was unsalted.
ex.zh: 這道湯味道很淡，因為高湯沒有加鹽。

ex.en: The police found that the man was unarmed.
ex.zh: 警方發現那名男子沒有帶武器。

ex.en: Unarmed civilians were asked to leave the area.
ex.zh: 手無寸鐵的平民被要求離開該區域。

ex.en: Soldiers must not shoot an unarmed person.
ex.zh: 士兵不得向手無寸鐵的人開槍。

ex.en: It is unethical to copy someone else's work and call it your own.
ex.zh: 抄襲別人的作品還說是自己的是不道德的。

ex.en: The company was criticized for its unethical business practices.
ex.zh: 那間公司因不道德的經營手法而受到批評。

ex.en: The detective investigated the city's criminal underworld.
ex.zh: 偵探調查這座城市的黑社會。

ex.en: In Greek myths, Hades rules the underworld.
ex.zh: 在希臘神話中，黑帝斯統治著冥界。

ex.en: He tends to understate his own talent when people praise him.
ex.zh: 別人稱讚他時，他總是把自己的才能說得很保守。

ex.en: Don't understate the risks just to make the plan sound good.
ex.zh: 別為了讓計畫聽起來不錯就把風險說得太輕。

ex.en: The storm caused untold damage to the town.
ex.zh: 暴風雨給小鎮造成了難以估計的損失。

ex.en: Untold numbers of birds visit the lake each winter.
ex.zh: 每年冬天有數不清的鳥來到這座湖。

ex.en: Every family has its untold stories.
ex.zh: 每個家庭都有未曾說出口的故事。

ex.en: He kept his untold secrets to himself for years.
ex.zh: 他把沒說出口的祕密藏在心裡多年。

ex.en: Saying the exam was hard is an understatement.
ex.zh: 說這次考試很難還算是輕描淡寫了。

ex.en: It would be an understatement to call the trip tiring.
ex.zh: 說這趟旅程累人，都還算說得保守了。

ex.en: He burst into uncontrollable laughter during the meeting.
ex.zh: 他在會議中爆出無法控制的大笑。

ex.en: The fire became uncontrollable once the wind picked up.
ex.zh: 風一變大，火勢就失控了。

ex.en: He looked uncertainly at the menu and asked for help.
ex.zh: 他猶豫地看著菜單，然後請人幫忙。

ex.en: "Maybe," she answered uncertainly.
ex.zh: 「也許吧。」她不太確定地回答。

ex.en: She is unquestionably the best player on the team.
ex.zh: 她毫無疑問是隊上最強的球員。

ex.en: The food was unquestionably worth the long wait.
ex.zh: 這些食物毫無疑問值得等那麼久。

ex.en: Members have unrestricted access to the library.
ex.zh: 會員可以不受限制地使用圖書館。

ex.en: The park offers unrestricted views of the mountains.
ex.zh: 這座公園擁有毫無遮擋的山景。

ex.en: Underwriting decides whether the insurer accepts the risk.
ex.zh: 承保審核決定保險公司是否接受這項風險。

ex.en: The bank handled the underwriting of the new stock offering.
ex.zh: 這家銀行負責新股發行的包銷。

ex.en: The market was unregulated for many years.
ex.zh: 這個市場多年來未受管制。

ex.en: Unregulated fishing can destroy fish populations.
ex.zh: 不受管制的捕魚會摧毀魚群數量。

ex.en: The cake was unbelievably good.
ex.zh: 這個蛋糕好吃得令人難以置信。

ex.en: He was unbelievably rude to the waiter.
ex.zh: 他對服務生無禮得令人不敢相信。

ex.en: The case remains unsolved after ten years.
ex.zh: 這個案子十年後仍未破獲。

ex.en: Some math problems have stayed unsolved for centuries.
ex.zh: 有些數學問題幾個世紀以來一直沒有解開。

ex.en: The trip was delayed because of unforeseen problems.
ex.zh: 由於發生了意料之外的問題，這趟旅行延後了。

ex.en: We keep some money aside for unforeseen costs.
ex.zh: 我們留一些錢以備不時之需的額外支出。

unscrupulous.zh: 不擇手段的；肆無忌憚的

ex.en: An unscrupulous seller cheated the old man out of his savings.
ex.zh: 一個不擇手段的賣家騙走了那位老人的積蓄。

ex.en: Be careful of unscrupulous people who promise easy money.
ex.zh: 要小心那些承諾輕鬆賺錢的無良之人。

ex.en: I'm feeling unwell, so I'll stay home today.
ex.zh: 我覺得不太舒服，今天要待在家。

ex.en: He looked pale and unwell after the long flight.
ex.zh: 長途飛行後，他看起來臉色蒼白、身體不適。

ex.en: The two events seem completely unconnected.
ex.zh: 這兩件事看起來完全沒有關聯。

ex.en: The printer is unconnected, so nothing will print.
ex.zh: 印表機沒有接上線，所以印不出任何東西。

ex.en: The shopkeeper was unfriendly and didn't even say hello.
ex.zh: 那個店員態度冷淡，連招呼都沒打。

ex.en: Some people think big cities are unfriendly places.
ex.zh: 有些人覺得大城市是不太親切的地方。

ex.en: The rumor turned out to be completely unfounded.
ex.zh: 事實證明那個謠言完全沒有根據。

ex.en: Her fears were unfounded, and the test went well.
ex.zh: 她的擔心是多餘的，考試考得很順利。

unchallenged.zh: 未受質疑的；無人挑戰的

ex.en: His claim went unchallenged because nobody knew the facts.
ex.zh: 他的說法沒有受到質疑，因為沒人知道事實。

ex.en: The champion held the title unchallenged for five years.
ex.zh: 這位冠軍在五年內無人能挑戰他的頭銜。

ex.en: The teacher used an unorthodox method to explain math.
ex.zh: 老師用一種不按常規的方法來講解數學。

ex.en: His unorthodox style of painting surprised the critics.
ex.zh: 他非傳統的繪畫風格讓評論家們驚訝。

ex.en: The thief targeted unsuspecting tourists in the crowd.
ex.zh: 小偷鎖定人群中毫無戒心的觀光客下手。

ex.en: The unsuspecting guests walked in to find a surprise party.
ex.zh: 毫不知情的客人們走進來，發現是個驚喜派對。

ex.en: The unrelenting rain lasted for three days.
ex.zh: 這場不停的大雨下了三天。

ex.en: She faced unrelenting pressure from her boss to finish the project.
ex.zh: 她承受著老闆不斷施加的壓力要完成專案。

ex.en: Both drivers walked away from the crash unscathed.
ex.zh: 兩位駕駛都毫髮無傷地走出事故現場。

ex.en: The old house remained unscathed after the storm.
ex.zh: 那棟老房子在暴風雨後完好無損。

ex.en: The view from the top is undeniably beautiful.
ex.zh: 山頂的景色無疑非常美。

ex.en: She is undeniably the best player on our team.
ex.zh: 她無疑是我們隊上最好的球員。

ex.en: The hotel offers unparalleled views of the sea.
ex.zh: 這間飯店擁有無與倫比的海景。

ex.en: The team enjoyed unparalleled success this year.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍今年取得了空前的成功。

unchecked.zh: 未受抑制的；未經檢查的

ex.en: Unchecked growth of weeds can ruin a garden.
ex.zh: 雜草不受控制地生長會毀掉花園。

ex.en: Unchecked bags are not allowed in the stadium.
ex.zh: 未經檢查的包包不能帶進球場。

unspeakable.zh: 無法形容的；說不出口的

ex.en: The family felt unspeakable sorrow after the loss.
ex.zh: 失去親人後，全家人悲痛得難以言喻。

ex.en: The soldiers saw unspeakable things during the war.
ex.zh: 士兵們在戰爭中目睹了難以言說的事。

ex.en: Leaves crunched underfoot as we walked through the park.
ex.zh: 我們走過公園時，腳下的落葉沙沙作響。

ex.en: The puppy kept getting underfoot while I cooked.
ex.zh: 我做飯時，小狗一直在腳邊礙事。

ex.en: His excuse sounded unconvincing to everyone.
ex.zh: 他的藉口對每個人來說都沒有說服力。

ex.en: The actor gave an unconvincing performance as a doctor.
ex.zh: 那位演員演的醫生很不具說服力。

ex.en: He felt unworthy of such a great honor.
ex.zh: 他覺得自己不配獲得這麼大的榮譽。

ex.en: That kind of behavior is unworthy of a good leader.
ex.zh: 那種行為不配當一個好領導者。

ex.en: An unmanned spacecraft landed on the moon.
ex.zh: 一艘無人太空船降落在月球上。

ex.en: The unmanned gate was open, so we walked through.
ex.zh: 那個無人看守的柵門是開的，我們就走了過去。

ex.en: The new coach is unifying the team after a bad season.
ex.zh: 新教練正在球隊一個糟糕的球季後讓大家團結起來。

ex.en: The festival is unifying people from different towns.
ex.zh: 這個節慶使來自不同城鎮的人們凝聚在一起。

ex.en: Can you untie the knot in my shoelace?
ex.zh: 你能幫我解開鞋帶上的結嗎？

ex.en: He untied the rope and let the boat drift.
ex.zh: 他解開繩子，讓船漂走。

ex.en: The manager was unsympathetic when he asked for a day off.
ex.zh: 他請假時，主管毫不體諒。

ex.en: Her unsympathetic reply made him feel worse.
ex.zh: 她冷漠的回答讓他更難過。

ex.en: His anger at the waiter was unwarranted.
ex.zh: 他對服務生發脾氣是沒有道理的。

ex.en: The report called the fears unwarranted.
ex.zh: 報告指出那些擔憂是沒有根據的。

ex.en: The table is unbalanced because one leg is shorter.
ex.zh: 這張桌子因為一隻腳比較短而不平衡。

ex.en: An unbalanced diet can make you feel tired.
ex.zh: 飲食不均衡會讓你覺得疲倦。

ex.en: He seemed unconcerned about the test results.
ex.zh: 他似乎不在乎考試結果。

ex.en: The cat stayed unconcerned by the noise outside.
ex.zh: 那隻貓對外面的噪音毫不在意。

ex.en: Trust is the underpinning of any good friendship.
ex.zh: 信任是任何良好友誼的基礎。

ex.en: Workers added a steel underpinning to the old wall.
ex.zh: 工人替舊牆加上鋼製的支撐結構。

ex.en: I need two uninterrupted hours to finish this report.
ex.zh: 我需要兩個小時不被打斷的時間來完成這份報告。

ex.en: They enjoyed an uninterrupted view of the sea.
ex.zh: 他們欣賞著一覽無遺的海景。

ex.en: She unequivocally rejected the offer.
ex.zh: 她明確地拒絕了這個提議。

ex.en: The report unequivocally states that the water is safe.
ex.zh: 報告明確指出這些水是安全的。

ex.en: The land near the lake is still undeveloped.
ex.zh: 湖邊那塊土地仍未開發。

ex.en: Many undeveloped regions need better roads.
ex.zh: 許多未開發地區需要更好的道路。

ex.en: The recipe is uncomplicated, so anyone can make it.
ex.zh: 這道食譜很簡單，任何人都做得出來。

ex.en: He wanted an uncomplicated life in a small town.
ex.zh: 他想在小鎮過簡單的生活。

ex.en: Is this seat unoccupied?
ex.zh: 這個位子沒人坐嗎？

ex.en: The house has been unoccupied for years.
ex.zh: 這棟房子已經空了好幾年。

unmoved.zh: 無動於衷的；不為所動的

ex.en: She stayed unmoved by his tears.
ex.zh: 她對他的眼淚無動於衷。

ex.en: The judge was unmoved by their excuses.
ex.zh: 法官不為他們的藉口所動。

ex.en: The company paid an undisclosed amount for the deal.
ex.zh: 公司為這筆交易付了一筆未公開的金額。

ex.en: The meeting will be held at an undisclosed location.
ex.zh: 會議將在不公開的地點舉行。

ex.en: Unhappily, the trip was cancelled because of the storm.
ex.zh: 很不幸，旅行因暴風雨而取消了。

ex.en: He stared unhappily at his empty plate.
ex.zh: 他悶悶不樂地盯著空盤子。

unproductive.zh: 沒有成效的；沒有生產力的

ex.en: The meeting was long and unproductive.
ex.zh: 這場會議又長又沒有成效。

ex.en: The soil here is dry and unproductive.
ex.zh: 這裡的土壤乾燥又貧瘠。

ex.en: The team finished the season undefeated.
ex.zh: 這支球隊以不敗的戰績完成了整個球季。

ex.en: She is still undefeated in her twenty matches.
ex.zh: 她二十場比賽至今仍未輸過。

ex.en: The unsightly stain on the wall bothered her.
ex.zh: 牆上難看的汙漬讓她很在意。

ex.en: They planted trees to hide the unsightly fence.
ex.zh: 他們種了樹來遮住那道難看的圍籬。

undulating.zh: 波動；起伏（undulate 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The flag was undulating gently in the breeze.
ex.zh: 旗幟在微風中輕輕地飄動。

ex.en: Snakes move by undulating their bodies.
ex.zh: 蛇靠著身體的波浪式擺動來移動。

ex.en: The shop was unprofitable and closed last year.
ex.zh: 那家店不賺錢，去年就關門了。

ex.en: It would be unprofitable to keep that old machine running.
ex.zh: 讓那台舊機器繼續運轉是划不來的。

ex.en: The room was unnaturally quiet after the news.
ex.zh: 聽到消息後，房間裡安靜得不自然。

ex.en: He smiled unnaturally for the camera.
ex.zh: 他對著鏡頭笑得很不自然。

ex.en: The old church has remained unaltered for two hundred years.
ex.zh: 這座老教堂兩百年來維持原貌。

ex.en: Her plans were unaltered by the bad weather.
ex.zh: 她的計畫沒有因為壞天氣而改變。

ex.en: She is the undisputed leader of the team.
ex.zh: 她是這支團隊毫無爭議的領導者。

ex.en: It is an undisputed fact that the Earth goes around the sun.
ex.zh: 地球繞著太陽轉是無可爭議的事實。

ex.en: The hotel was clean but unremarkable.
ex.zh: 那家旅館很乾淨，但沒什麼特色。

ex.en: He led an unremarkable life in a small town.
ex.zh: 他在小鎮過著平凡的生活。

ex.en: He unzipped his jacket because the room was warm.
ex.zh: 房間很暖，他拉開了外套的拉鍊。

ex.en: Please unzip the bag and take out the umbrella.
ex.zh: 請拉開背包拉鍊，把雨傘拿出來。

ex.en: You need to unzip the file before you can open it.
ex.zh: 你得先把檔案解壓縮才能打開它。

ex.en: I unzipped the folder and found three photos inside.
ex.zh: 我解壓縮了資料夾，發現裡面有三張照片。

unrivalled.zh: 無與倫比的；無人能敵的

ex.en: The chef has an unrivalled reputation in the city.
ex.zh: 這位主廚在城裡的聲望無人能比。

ex.en: The hotel offers an unrivalled view of the mountains.
ex.zh: 這間旅館擁有無與倫比的山景。

ex.en: The mayor's unpopularity grew after the tax increase.
ex.zh: 加稅之後，市長越來越不受歡迎。

ex.en: The film's unpopularity surprised its makers.
ex.zh: 這部電影不受歡迎，讓製作人很意外。

unimpressed.zh: 不為所動的；不覺得了不起的

ex.en: The teacher was unimpressed by his excuse.
ex.zh: 老師對他的藉口不以為然。

ex.en: She looked unimpressed with the magic trick.
ex.zh: 她看起來對那個魔術沒什麼感覺。

ex.en: It is illegal to sell alcohol to underage customers.
ex.zh: 把酒賣給未成年的顧客是違法的。

ex.en: The club checks ID to keep out underage drinkers.
ex.zh: 那間夜店會查身分證，不讓未成年者喝酒。

ex.en: The old man followed an unchanging daily routine.
ex.zh: 那位老先生過著一成不變的日常生活。

ex.en: Her love for him was strong and unchanging.
ex.zh: 她對他的愛堅定而始終不變。

ex.en: Women are still underrepresented in some fields.
ex.zh: 女性在某些領域的比例仍然偏低。

ex.en: The program helps students from underrepresented communities.
ex.zh: 這個計畫協助來自代表性不足社群的學生。

ex.en: The sailors unfurl the sails at dawn.
ex.zh: 水手們在黎明時展開船帆。

ex.en: The flag began to unfurl in the wind.
ex.zh: 旗子在風中開始展開。

ex.en: The silence in the empty house was unsettling.
ex.zh: 空屋裡的寂靜令人不安。

ex.en: She had an unsettling feeling that someone was watching her.
ex.zh: 她有種令人不安的感覺，好像有人在看著她。

ex.en: There is an unwritten rule not to be late to class.
ex.zh: 上課不遲到是一條不成文的規定。

ex.en: The tale was passed down as an unwritten tradition.
ex.zh: 這個故事以口耳相傳的方式流傳下來。

ex.en: The last page of the notebook was still unwritten.
ex.zh: 筆記本的最後一頁還是空白的。

ex.en: The future is unwritten, so anything is possible.
ex.zh: 未來還沒有定數，所以一切皆有可能。

ex.en: He was unaccustomed to waking up so early.
ex.zh: 他不習慣這麼早起床。

ex.en: She felt shy, unaccustomed to speaking in front of crowds.
ex.zh: 她不習慣在大眾面前說話，覺得很害羞。

ex.en: The rules state unambiguously that phones are not allowed.
ex.zh: 規則明確寫明不得使用手機。

ex.en: She unambiguously refused the offer.
ex.zh: 她明確地拒絕了這項提議。

ex.en: Her father was strict and unforgiving about lies.
ex.zh: 她父親對說謊既嚴格又不寬容。

ex.en: The desert is an unforgiving place for those without water.
ex.zh: 對沒帶水的人來說，沙漠是個嚴酷的地方。

ex.en: The disease can remain undetected for years.
ex.zh: 這種疾病可能多年都不被發現。

ex.en: The thief entered the house undetected.
ex.zh: 小偷在沒被發現的情況下進了屋子。

ex.en: The shop discounted its unsold clothes at the end of the season.
ex.zh: 這家店在季末把賣不出去的衣服打折。

ex.en: Many unsold tickets were returned to the box office.
ex.zh: 許多沒賣出的票被退回售票處。

uneducated.zh: 未受教育的；沒受過教育的

ex.en: Many of the villagers were uneducated and could not read.
ex.zh: 許多村民沒受過教育，不識字。

ex.en: It is unfair to call someone stupid just because they are uneducated.
ex.zh: 只因為某人沒受過教育就說他笨是不公平的。

ex.en: The ladder felt unsteady under his weight.
ex.zh: 梯子在他的重量下感覺搖搖晃晃。

ex.en: The baby took a few unsteady steps toward her mother.
ex.zh: 寶寶搖搖晃晃地朝媽媽走了幾步。

unspoilt.zh: 未受破壞的；保持原貌的

ex.en: We found an unspoilt beach with no hotels nearby.
ex.zh: 我們找到一片附近沒有飯店、保持原貌的海灘。

ex.en: The village is still unspoilt by tourism.
ex.zh: 這個村莊仍未被觀光業破壞。

ex.en: The cake smelled unmistakably of chocolate.
ex.zh: 這個蛋糕聞起來顯然是巧克力的味道。

ex.en: Her handwriting is unmistakably neat.
ex.zh: 她的字跡明顯地整齊。

ex.en: The unending noise from the street kept me awake.
ex.zh: 街上不停的噪音讓我睡不著。

ex.en: The farmers faced an unending list of chores.
ex.zh: 農夫們面對著一長串做不完的雜事。

ex.en: A judge must give an unbiased decision.
ex.zh: 法官必須做出公正的裁決。

ex.en: The report offers an unbiased view of both sides.
ex.zh: 這份報告對雙方提供了不偏不倚的看法。

ex.en: He is a quiet, unassuming man who never brags.
ex.zh: 他是個安靜、謙遜的人，從不炫耀。

ex.en: The unassuming little cafe serves the best coffee in town.
ex.zh: 這間不起眼的小咖啡館供應全鎮最好喝的咖啡。

ex.en: My cousin showed up unannounced at our door.
ex.zh: 我表哥沒事先通知就出現在我們家門口。

ex.en: The boss made an unannounced visit to the factory.
ex.zh: 老闆突然來工廠視察，事先沒有通知。

ex.en: Children need unfettered time to play.
ex.zh: 孩子需要不受拘束的玩耍時間。

ex.en: The artist enjoyed unfettered freedom in her work.
ex.zh: 這位藝術家在創作上享有不受限制的自由。

ex.en: An untrained eye might not notice the difference.
ex.zh: 未經訓練的眼睛可能看不出差別。

ex.en: The untrained volunteers needed some guidance on their first day.
ex.zh: 這些沒受過訓練的志工第一天需要一些指導。

unsolicited.zh: 未經請求的；主動提供的

ex.en: I keep getting unsolicited emails from strangers.
ex.zh: 我一直收到陌生人寄來的垃圾郵件。

ex.en: He gave me some unsolicited advice about my career.
ex.zh: 他主動給了我一些我沒問的職涯建議。

ex.en: Once the team got going, they seemed unstoppable.
ex.zh: 球隊一旦進入狀況，似乎就無人能擋。

ex.en: Change is unstoppable, so we must learn to adapt.
ex.zh: 改變是擋不住的，所以我們必須學會適應。

ex.en: I unintentionally deleted the file.
ex.zh: 我不小心把檔案刪掉了。

ex.en: She unintentionally hurt his feelings with that joke.
ex.zh: 她無意間因為那個玩笑傷了他的心。

ex.en: Swimmers should beware of the strong undercurrent here.
ex.zh: 游泳的人要小心這裡強勁的暗流。

ex.en: The river looked calm, but there was a dangerous undercurrent.
ex.zh: 河面看似平靜，底下卻有危險的暗流。

undercurrent.zh: 潛在的情緒；暗地裡的傾向

ex.en: There was an undercurrent of tension in the meeting.
ex.zh: 會議中暗藏著緊張的氣氛。

ex.en: I sensed an undercurrent of sadness in her words.
ex.zh: 我從她的話裡感覺到一股淡淡的哀傷。

ex.en: He felt a growing uneasiness as night fell.
ex.zh: 夜幕降臨，他越來越不安。

ex.en: She tried to hide her uneasiness before the interview.
ex.zh: 面試前她試著掩飾自己的不安。

unwieldy.zh: 笨重難用的；難以處理的

ex.en: The box was too large and unwieldy to carry alone.
ex.zh: 這個箱子太大又笨重，一個人搬不動。

ex.en: The company has an unwieldy system that slows everyone down.
ex.zh: 公司的系統龐雜難用，拖慢了每個人。

uncharted.zh: 未知的；未標在地圖上的

ex.en: The ship sailed into uncharted waters.
ex.zh: 船駛入了未標示於海圖上的海域。

ex.en: Starting a business was uncharted territory for her.
ex.zh: 創業對她來說是全新未知的領域。

ex.en: The universality of music is easy to see across cultures.
ex.zh: 音樂的普遍性在各種文化中都看得出來。

ex.en: Scientists test the universality of a law with many experiments.
ex.zh: 科學家用許多實驗來檢驗一項定律的普遍性。

ex.en: She laughed uncontrollably at the funny video.
ex.zh: 她看著那段搞笑影片，笑得無法自制。

ex.en: His hands were shaking uncontrollably from the cold.
ex.zh: 他的雙手因為寒冷而不停地顫抖。

untested.zh: 未經測試的；未經考驗的

ex.en: The company does not want to sell an untested product.
ex.zh: 公司不想販售未經測試的產品。

ex.en: She was a young, untested leader when she took the job.
ex.zh: 她接下這份工作時是個年輕、未經考驗的領導者。

ex.en: The man was arrested for unlawfully entering the building.
ex.zh: 那名男子因非法闖入大樓而被逮捕。

ex.en: The company unlawfully dismissed several workers.
ex.zh: 這家公司非法解僱了好幾名員工。

ex.en: This car runs only on unleaded gasoline.
ex.zh: 這輛車只能加無鉛汽油。

ex.en: Unleaded fuel is better for the environment.
ex.zh: 無鉛燃料對環境比較好。

ex.en: The crowd greeted the singer with unbridled joy.
ex.zh: 群眾以無拘無束的喜悅迎接這位歌手。

ex.en: His unbridled anger scared everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 他失控的怒氣嚇到了房裡的每個人。

ex.en: The region is still underdeveloped and has few roads.
ex.zh: 這個地區仍欠缺開發，道路很少。

ex.en: The plant stayed small and underdeveloped in the shade.
ex.zh: 那株植物在陰暗處一直長得矮小、發育不良。

ex.en: The detective met some unsavory characters in the alley.
ex.zh: 偵探在巷子裡遇到一些不三不四的人。

ex.en: The restaurant had an unsavory reputation for dirty kitchens.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳因廚房骯髒而名聲不佳。

ex.en: He seemed uninterested in the topic and looked out the window.
ex.zh: 他似乎對這個話題不感興趣，一直看著窗外。

ex.en: She was completely uninterested in sports.
ex.zh: 她對運動完全不感興趣。

ex.en: He unbuttoned his coat as soon as he entered the warm room.
ex.zh: 他一走進暖和的房間就解開了外套的釦子。

ex.en: The doctor asked her to unbutton her shirt.
ex.zh: 醫生請她解開襯衫的釦子。

ex.en: The chef's skill is unmatched in this city.
ex.zh: 這位主廚的手藝在這座城市裡無人能比。

ex.en: The view from the mountain top is unmatched.
ex.zh: 山頂上的景色無與倫比。

ex.en: I found an unmatched sock at the bottom of the basket.
ex.zh: 我在籃子底部找到一隻落單的襪子。

ex.en: The room was full of unmatched chairs and old tables.
ex.zh: 房間裡擺滿了不成套的椅子和舊桌子。

ex.en: Spending more than you earn is unsustainable.
ex.zh: 花得比賺得多是無法長久維持的。

ex.en: Scientists warn that the current rate of fishing is unsustainable.
ex.zh: 科學家警告，目前的捕魚速度是無法持續的。

unrecognized.zh: 未被認出的；未被承認的

ex.en: He walked through the crowd unrecognized in his hat and glasses.
ex.zh: 他戴著帽子和眼鏡穿過人群，沒有被認出來。

ex.en: The artist's talent went unrecognized for many years.
ex.zh: 這位藝術家的才華多年來一直未被肯定。

ex.en: The region declared independence, but it remains an unrecognized state.
ex.zh: 該地區宣布獨立，但仍是一個未被承認的國家。

ex.en: The degree is unrecognized in many countries.
ex.zh: 這個學位在許多國家不被承認。

undiscovered.zh: 未被發現的；不為人知的

ex.en: The island remained undiscovered for hundreds of years.
ex.zh: 這座島嶼數百年來一直未被人發現。

ex.en: She was an undiscovered talent working in a small café.
ex.zh: 她是一位在小咖啡館工作、尚未被發掘的人才。

ex.en: Many species in the deep sea are still undiscovered.
ex.zh: 深海中仍有許多物種尚未被發現。

ex.en: She showed an unyielding spirit during the long campaign.
ex.zh: 在漫長的活動中，她展現了不屈的精神。

ex.en: The unyielding ground was too hard to dig.
ex.zh: 堅硬的地面硬到無法挖掘。

ex.en: He remained unyielding in his demand for fair pay.
ex.zh: 他在爭取合理薪資的要求上毫不讓步。

ex.en: The artist left the painting untitled.
ex.zh: 藝術家沒有為這幅畫命名。

ex.en: I found an untitled document on my desktop.
ex.zh: 我在桌面上發現一份沒有標題的文件。

untenable.zh: 站不住腳的；難以維持的

ex.en: His argument was untenable once the facts came out.
ex.zh: 事實揭露後，他的論點就站不住腳了。

ex.en: The company's position became untenable after the loss.
ex.zh: 虧損之後，公司的處境變得難以為繼。

ex.en: It is untenable to claim that nothing needs to change.
ex.zh: 聲稱什麼都不需要改變是說不通的。

ex.en: In the story, a white unicorn lived deep in the forest.
ex.zh: 故事裡，一隻白色的獨角獸住在森林深處。

ex.en: My niece drew a unicorn with a rainbow mane.
ex.zh: 我外甥女畫了一隻有彩虹鬃毛的獨角獸。

ex.en: Undaunted by the storm, she kept climbing.
ex.zh: 她不畏風暴，繼續往上爬。

ex.en: He remained undaunted despite several failures.
ex.zh: 儘管失敗了好幾次，他依然無所畏懼。

ex.en: We made an unplanned stop at a small bakery.
ex.zh: 我們臨時在一間小麵包店停了下來。

ex.en: The unplanned visit surprised everyone.
ex.zh: 這次意料之外的拜訪讓大家都很驚訝。

ex.en: Do not eat uncooked chicken.
ex.zh: 不要吃沒煮過的雞肉。

ex.en: Keep the uncooked rice in a dry container.
ex.zh: 把生米放在乾燥的容器裡。

ex.en: The children rushed to unwrap their presents.
ex.zh: 孩子們急著拆開他們的禮物。

ex.en: Please unwrap the sandwich before you eat it.
ex.zh: 吃三明治之前請先拆掉包裝。

ex.en: The unwed couple decided to live together before planning a wedding.
ex.zh: 這對未婚的伴侶決定在籌備婚禮前先住在一起。

ex.en: She was an unwed mother at the age of nineteen.
ex.zh: 她十九歲時是一位未婚媽媽。

ex.en: Much of the deep ocean is still unexplored.
ex.zh: 深海的大部分地區仍未被探索。

ex.en: They set out to visit the unexplored parts of the forest.
ex.zh: 他們出發前往森林中尚未探索的地方。

ex.en: The factory workers are unionized and have regular meetings.
ex.zh: 這間工廠的工人加入了工會，也固定開會。

ex.en: A unionized workforce can negotiate better pay.
ex.zh: 有工會組織的勞工更能爭取較高的薪資。

ex.en: She showed unwavering support for her friend.
ex.zh: 她對朋友展現出堅定不移的支持。

ex.en: His unwavering belief in hard work finally paid off.
ex.zh: 他對努力工作堅定不移的信念終於有了回報。

uninformed.zh: 不知情的；消息不靈通的

ex.en: Voters who are uninformed may make poor choices.
ex.zh: 對資訊不了解的選民可能會做出不好的選擇。

ex.en: I was left uninformed about the change in plans.
ex.zh: 計畫有變，但沒有人通知我。

ex.en: The voters hoped to unseat the mayor in the next election.
ex.zh: 選民希望在下次選舉中讓市長下台。

ex.en: The scandal could unseat the whole board of directors.
ex.zh: 這個醜聞可能讓整個董事會下台。

ex.en: The wild horse unseated its rider at the first jump.
ex.zh: 那匹野馬在第一次跳躍時就把騎士摔了下來。

ex.en: A sudden noise unseated the young jockey.
ex.zh: 一個突如其來的聲響把年輕的騎師震下了馬。

ex.en: He packed socks and underpants for the weekend trip.
ex.zh: 他為週末旅行打包了襪子和內褲。

ex.en: The child put his underpants on backward.
ex.zh: 那個孩子把內褲穿反了。

ex.en: Many underfunded schools cannot afford new books.
ex.zh: 許多經費不足的學校買不起新書。

ex.en: The clinic is underfunded and always short of supplies.
ex.zh: 這間診所經費不足，物資總是短缺。

unraveled.zh: 解開；拆散（unravel 的過去式）

ex.en: The sweater unraveled when the thread was pulled.
ex.zh: 線一拉，毛衣就鬆脫了。

ex.en: The detective unraveled the mystery in the last chapter.
ex.zh: 偵探在最後一章解開了謎團。

ex.en: He was uncharacteristically quiet during the meeting.
ex.zh: 他在會議上一反常態地安靜。

ex.en: The weather was uncharacteristically warm for December.
ex.zh: 十二月的天氣暖得不尋常。

ex.en: She uncharacteristically forgot her friend's birthday.
ex.zh: 她一反常態地忘了朋友的生日。

ex.en: The strange noise left me feeling unsettled.
ex.zh: 那個奇怪的聲音讓我覺得心神不寧。

ex.en: She felt unsettled after moving to a new city.
ex.zh: 搬到新城市後，她覺得心裡不踏實。

ex.en: The question of who will pay is still unsettled.
ex.zh: 誰要付錢的問題仍未解決。

ex.en: They left the argument unsettled and went home.
ex.zh: 他們沒有解決爭執就回家了。

ex.en: The weather has been unsettled all week, with sun and rain.
ex.zh: 整週天氣都不穩定，時晴時雨。

ex.en: The unsettled situation made investors nervous.
ex.zh: 不穩定的局勢讓投資人感到緊張。

ex.en: Please unscrew the lid and pour out the juice.
ex.zh: 請旋開蓋子，把果汁倒出來。

ex.en: He used a coin to unscrew the battery cover.
ex.zh: 他用硬幣把電池蓋擰開。

ex.en: After the long illness, he was almost unrecognizable.
ex.zh: 生了一場大病後，他幾乎讓人認不出來。

ex.en: The old neighborhood is unrecognizable now.
ex.zh: 那個老社區現在已面目全非。

ex.en: The singer's untimely death shocked her fans.
ex.zh: 那位歌手的英年早逝震驚了她的粉絲。

ex.en: It was an untimely remark and everyone fell silent.
ex.zh: 那是句不合時宜的話，大家都安靜了下來。

ex.en: A deer slipped quietly into the underbrush.
ex.zh: 一隻鹿悄悄溜進了灌木叢。

ex.en: We had to push through thick underbrush to reach the stream.
ex.zh: 我們得撥開濃密的灌木叢才能走到小溪。

ex.en: The patient was unresponsive when the paramedics arrived.
ex.zh: 救護人員抵達時，病人已失去反應。

ex.en: The website was unresponsive, so I closed it.
ex.zh: 那個網站毫無反應，所以我把它關掉了。

unresponsive.zh: 反應遲鈍的；不為所動的

ex.en: The company has been unresponsive to customer complaints.
ex.zh: 這家公司對客戶的抱怨一直置之不理。

ex.en: He stayed unresponsive to all our questions.
ex.zh: 他對我們所有的問題都沒有回應。

ex.en: The little girl unwrapped the gift and squealed with joy.
ex.zh: 小女孩拆開禮物，開心地尖叫起來。

ex.en: He carefully unwrapped the sandwich and began to eat.
ex.zh: 他小心地拆開三明治的包裝，開始吃了起來。

ex.en: Unwrapped candy should not be left out in the open.
ex.zh: 沒有包裝的糖果不該放在外面。

ex.en: The shop sells unwrapped soap by weight.
ex.zh: 那間店按重量販售沒有包裝的肥皂。

ex.en: The mistake was unintentional, and she apologized right away.
ex.zh: 那個錯誤是無心的，她立刻道了歉。

ex.en: His rude comment was completely unintentional.
ex.zh: 他那句失禮的話完全是無意的。

ex.en: The driver walked away from the crash unharmed.
ex.zh: 那位駕駛從車禍中毫髮無傷地走了出來。

ex.en: The missing hikers were found unharmed after two days.
ex.zh: 失蹤的登山客兩天後被發現，平安無事。

ex.en: The coach's authority was unquestioned in the team.
ex.zh: 教練在球隊中的權威無人質疑。

ex.en: Their loyalty to the family remained unquestioned.
ex.zh: 他們對家族的忠誠始終無人懷疑。

ex.en: The undersecretary attended the meeting on behalf of the minister.
ex.zh: 次長代表部長出席了會議。

ex.en: She was appointed undersecretary of education last year.
ex.zh: 她去年被任命為教育部次長。

ex.en: He admitted he had been unfaithful to his wife.
ex.zh: 他承認自己對妻子不忠。

ex.en: She left him after learning he was unfaithful.
ex.zh: 得知他出軌後，她離開了他。

ex.en: The star player seemed untouchable on the court.
ex.zh: 那位明星球員在場上似乎無人能擋。

ex.en: In this company, the boss feels untouchable.
ex.zh: 在這家公司，老闆覺得自己動不得。

unabashed.zh: 毫不羞愧的；大方坦率的

ex.en: He is an unabashed fan of the band.
ex.zh: 他是這個樂團毫不掩飾的粉絲。

ex.en: She spoke with unabashed pride about her son.
ex.zh: 她毫不害臊地驕傲談起她的兒子。

ex.en: It is a small, unpretentious restaurant with good food.
ex.zh: 這是一家小小的、樸實無華又好吃的餐廳。

ex.en: He is an unpretentious man who never shows off.
ex.zh: 他是個從不炫耀、不矯揉造作的人。

ex.en: He was an unwitting victim of the scam.
ex.zh: 他是這起詐騙中不知情的受害者。

ex.en: She made an unwitting mistake.
ex.zh: 她犯了一個無心的錯誤。

ex.en: I found the lecture long and uninteresting.
ex.zh: 我覺得那場演講又長又無趣。

ex.en: He told an uninteresting story about his trip.
ex.zh: 他講了一個關於旅行的乏味故事。

unaided.zh: 沒有協助的、未借助外力的

ex.en: He climbed the stairs unaided.
ex.zh: 他不靠旁人協助自己爬上樓梯。

ex.en: Stars can be seen with the unaided eye.
ex.zh: 用肉眼就能看見星星。

ex.en: I'm still unconvinced that this plan will work.
ex.zh: 我仍然不相信這個計畫行得通。

ex.en: The jury remained unconvinced by his story.
ex.zh: 陪審團對他的說法依然半信半疑。

ex.en: She nodded politely, but she looked unconvinced.
ex.zh: 她禮貌地點點頭，但看起來並不信服。

unobtrusive.zh: 不引人注目的；不礙眼的

ex.en: The waiter was polite and unobtrusive throughout dinner.
ex.zh: 整頓晚餐中，服務生都很有禮貌又不打擾人。

ex.en: We chose an unobtrusive color for the walls.
ex.zh: 我們為牆壁選了不顯眼的顏色。

ex.en: She tried to be unobtrusive as she slipped into the meeting late.
ex.zh: 她遲到溜進會議室時，努力不引人注意。

untoward.zh: 不幸的；麻煩的；不恰當的

ex.en: Nothing untoward happened during the trip.
ex.zh: 旅途中沒有發生任何不愉快的事。

ex.en: The police found nothing untoward in the house.
ex.zh: 警方在屋裡沒發現任何不對勁的地方。

ex.en: Those wide trousers are unfashionable now.
ex.zh: 那種寬褲現在已經不流行了。

ex.en: He wore an unfashionable hat, but he didn't care.
ex.zh: 他戴了一頂過時的帽子，但他不在意。

ex.en: She unknowingly stepped on his foot in the crowd.
ex.zh: 她在人群中不經意地踩到他的腳。

ex.en: Many people unknowingly share their private information online.
ex.zh: 許多人在無意間把個人資料公開到網路上。

ex.en: They spoke in an undertone so no one would hear.
ex.zh: 他們壓低聲音說話，免得被人聽到。

ex.en: His praise had an undertone of jealousy.
ex.zh: 他的稱讚帶著一絲嫉妒的意味。

ex.en: The paint has a warm pink undertone.
ex.zh: 這種油漆帶有暖暖的粉紅底色。

ex.en: Choose a makeup shade that matches your skin's undertone.
ex.zh: 挑選與你膚色底調相配的彩妝色號。

ex.en: The teacher called the essay dull and unimaginative.
ex.zh: 老師說那篇作文呆板又缺乏想像力。

ex.en: An unimaginative gift like socks won't make her happy.
ex.zh: 像襪子這種毫無新意的禮物不會讓她開心。

ex.en: The soup was cold and unpalatable.
ex.zh: 那碗湯又冷又難吃。

ex.en: The manager had to tell the team an unpalatable truth.
ex.zh: 經理得告訴團隊一個令人難以接受的事實。

ex.en: The two groups formed an unholy alliance.
ex.zh: 這兩個團體組成了邪惡的同盟。

ex.en: Their plan was an unholy mix of greed and lies.
ex.zh: 他們的計畫是貪婪與謊言的邪惡混合。

ex.en: The kids were making an unholy noise upstairs.
ex.zh: 孩子們在樓上製造出可怕的噪音。

ex.en: We got up at some unholy hour to catch the flight.
ex.zh: 為了趕飛機，我們在一個荒唐的鐘點起床。

ex.en: It is unconscionable to charge so much for basic medicine.
ex.zh: 基本藥品收這麼貴是不合理的。

ex.en: They made us wait for an unconscionable length of time.
ex.zh: 他們讓我們等了過分長的時間。

unassailable.zh: 無可置疑的；牢不可破的

ex.en: The team held an unassailable lead at halftime.
ex.zh: 球隊在中場休息時握有穩固的領先。

ex.en: His logic seemed unassailable, and no one could argue back.
ex.zh: 他的邏輯看起來無懈可擊，沒人能反駁。

ex.en: The company promised to refund the money unconditionally.
ex.zh: 公司承諾無條件退款。

ex.en: She loves her children unconditionally, no matter what they do.
ex.zh: 她無條件地愛著孩子們，不論他們做什麼。

ex.en: Many rural areas are still underserved by public transport.
ex.zh: 許多鄉村地區的大眾運輸仍然不足。

ex.en: The new clinic will help underserved communities get medical care.
ex.zh: 新診所將幫助資源不足的社區取得醫療照護。

unfathomable.zh: 深不可測的；難以理解的

ex.en: The loss of a child is an unfathomable pain.
ex.zh: 失去孩子是難以想像的痛苦。

ex.en: Scientists are studying the unfathomable depths of the ocean.
ex.zh: 科學家正在研究深不可測的海洋深處。

ex.en: Unaccompanied children must sit with a flight attendant.
ex.zh: 無人陪同的兒童必須由空服員陪同入座。

ex.en: She sang an unaccompanied song at the concert.
ex.zh: 她在音樂會上演唱了一首無伴奏的歌。

ex.en: He had unkempt hair and a messy beard.
ex.zh: 他頭髮蓬亂，鬍子也沒整理。

ex.en: The garden looked unkempt after months of neglect.
ex.zh: 花園荒廢幾個月後看起來雜亂不堪。

ex.en: He unashamedly admitted that he loved sweet snacks.
ex.zh: 他毫不害臊地承認自己愛吃甜食。

ex.en: She unashamedly cried at the end of the movie.
ex.zh: 她看完電影結尾時毫不掩飾地哭了。

ex.en: The paint dried unevenly on the wall.
ex.zh: 油漆在牆上乾得不均勻。

ex.en: Wealth is distributed unevenly across the country.
ex.zh: 財富在全國分配得並不平均。

ex.en: It is untypical of her to be late.
ex.zh: 她遲到是很不尋常的事。

ex.en: The weather this week is untypical for the season.
ex.zh: 這個星期的天氣不像這個季節常見的樣子。

ex.en: Running the old factory had become uneconomic.
ex.zh: 經營那間舊工廠已經變得不划算。

ex.en: It is uneconomic to fix such an old machine.
ex.zh: 修理這麼舊的機器不划算。

ex.en: The rules for the contest are still undefined.
ex.zh: 比賽規則仍然不明確。

ex.en: The program shows an error when a value is undefined.
ex.zh: 當某個值未定義時，程式會顯示錯誤。

ex.en: The reporter helped unmask the corrupt official.
ex.zh: 那位記者協助揭發了貪腐官員。

ex.en: The detective tried to unmask the thief.
ex.zh: 偵探試圖揭穿小偷的真面目。

ex.en: Unofficially, the meeting ended at six, but we kept talking until seven.
ex.zh: 非正式地說，會議六點就結束了，但我們一直聊到七點。

ex.en: The manager told me unofficially that I would get the job.
ex.zh: 經理私下告訴我，我會得到這份工作。

unplugged.zh: 拔掉插頭（unplug 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: I unplugged the lamp before changing the light bulb.
ex.zh: 我在換燈泡之前先拔掉了檯燈的插頭。

ex.en: She unplugged the heater and went to bed.
ex.zh: 她拔掉暖爐的插頭就去睡覺了。

ex.en: Someone had unplugged the fridge, and the food was spoiled.
ex.zh: 有人把冰箱的插頭拔掉了，食物都壞了。

ex.en: The scam is designed to trick unwary tourists.
ex.zh: 這種詐騙是設計來騙不夠警覺的觀光客。

ex.en: An unwary hiker can easily slip on the wet rocks.
ex.zh: 不小心的登山客很容易在濕滑的岩石上滑倒。

ex.en: Critics compared the new film unfavourably with the original.
ex.zh: 評論家把這部新電影和原版相比，給了較差的評價。

ex.en: The weather affected the harvest unfavourably this year.
ex.zh: 今年的天氣對收成造成了不利的影響。

ex.en: Undeterred by the rain, they continued their walk.
ex.zh: 他們沒被雨嚇退，繼續散步。

ex.en: She remained undeterred after failing the exam twice.
ex.zh: 她考試失敗兩次後依然沒有氣餒。

ex.en: He unwillingly agreed to help his brother move.
ex.zh: 他不情願地答應幫哥哥搬家。

ex.en: The child unwillingly put away his toys and went to bed.
ex.zh: 孩子不情願地收好玩具去睡覺。

ex.en: This thin jacket is unsuited to the cold weather.
ex.zh: 這件薄外套不適合這種寒冷的天氣。

ex.en: He felt unsuited for a job that required so much talking.
ex.zh: 他覺得自己不適合一份需要大量說話的工作。

ex.en: The bar had a reputation for attracting unsavoury characters.
ex.zh: 那間酒吧以會吸引一些不三不四的人而聞名。

ex.en: We left the restaurant because of the unsavoury smell from the kitchen.
ex.zh: 因為廚房傳來難聞的氣味，我們離開了那家餐廳。

ex.en: They sailed to a small uninhabited island in the Pacific.
ex.zh: 他們航行到太平洋上一座無人居住的小島。

ex.en: The old house has been uninhabited for many years.
ex.zh: 那棟老房子已經空了很多年，沒有人住。

ex.en: It took me ten minutes to untangle my earphones.
ex.zh: 我花了十分鐘才解開糾纏在一起的耳機線。

ex.en: The lawyers are trying to untangle the facts of the case.
ex.zh: 律師們正努力理清這個案子的事實。

ex.en: It was uncharacteristic of him to be late for work.
ex.zh: 他上班遲到真不像他平常的作風。

ex.en: She made an uncharacteristic mistake in the final report.
ex.zh: 她在最後報告裡犯了一個不像她會犯的錯。

ex.en: He unhooked the leash and let the dog run free.
ex.zh: 他解開牽繩的扣環，讓狗自由奔跑。

ex.en: Can you unhook my necklace? I can't reach the clasp.
ex.zh: 你可以幫我解開項鍊嗎？我搆不到扣環。

ex.en: The old bridge was declared structurally unsound.
ex.zh: 那座舊橋被判定在結構上不安全。

ex.en: His plan was based on unsound reasoning.
ex.zh: 他的計畫是建立在站不住腳的推論上。

ex.en: I like my tea unsweetened.
ex.zh: 我喜歡喝不加糖的茶。

ex.en: She bought unsweetened soy milk at the store.
ex.zh: 她在店裡買了無糖豆漿。

ex.en: Many people said the decision was undemocratic.
ex.zh: 許多人說這項決定不民主。

ex.en: The club has an undemocratic system where only one person decides everything.
ex.zh: 這個社團的制度不民主，所有事情只由一個人決定。

ex.en: He was hurt by his uncaring father.
ex.zh: 他被漠不關心的父親傷了心。

ex.en: The company seemed cold and uncaring toward its workers.
ex.zh: 這家公司對員工似乎冷漠又不關心。

ex.en: The storm continued unabated through the night.
ex.zh: 暴風雨整夜持續不減。

ex.en: Her enthusiasm for the project remained unabated.
ex.zh: 她對這個專案的熱情絲毫未減。

ex.en: The sticker came unstuck from the window.
ex.zh: 貼紙從窗戶上脫落了。

ex.en: The stamp got unstuck and fell off the envelope.
ex.zh: 郵票鬆脫，從信封上掉了下來。

ex.en: Our plan came unstuck when the funding was cut.
ex.zh: 資金被砍後，我們的計畫就失敗了。

ex.en: His argument came unstuck under questioning.
ex.zh: 他的論點在被質問時就站不住腳了。

ex.en: Years of unremitting work finally paid off.
ex.zh: 多年不懈的努力終於有了回報。

ex.en: The unremitting rain ruined our holiday.
ex.zh: 連綿不斷的雨毀了我們的假期。

ex.en: An uninvited guest showed up at the party.
ex.zh: 一位不請自來的客人出現在派對上。

ex.en: I felt awkward being there uninvited.
ex.zh: 我沒受邀卻在那裡，覺得很尷尬。

ex.en: Perfection is an unattainable goal for most people.
ex.zh: 對大多數人來說，完美是無法達到的目標。

ex.en: The prize seemed unattainable until she trained harder.
ex.zh: 在她更努力訓練之前，那個獎項似乎遙不可及。

ex.en: Unsurprisingly, the team won again.
ex.zh: 不出所料，這支隊伍又贏了。

ex.en: He was late again, unsurprisingly.
ex.zh: 他又遲到了，一點也不意外。

ex.en: The report made several unsupported claims.
ex.zh: 這份報告提出了幾項沒有證據支持的說法。

ex.en: An unsupported theory is hard to trust.
ex.zh: 沒有根據的理論很難讓人相信。

ex.en: The unsupported shelf fell down under the weight.
ex.zh: 那個沒有支撐的架子承受不住重量而掉了下來。

ex.en: The bridge was unsupported in the middle.
ex.zh: 這座橋的中段沒有支撐。

ex.en: The undersea cable carries internet data between continents.
ex.zh: 海底電纜在各大洲之間傳送網路資料。

ex.en: They explored an undersea cave full of colorful fish.
ex.zh: 他們探索了一個滿是彩色魚群的海底洞穴。

unpromising.zh: 沒有前途的、不被看好的

ex.en: The project looked unpromising at first.
ex.zh: 這個專案一開始看起來沒什麼希望。

ex.en: He turned an unpromising start into a win.
ex.zh: 他把不被看好的開局變成了勝利。

ex.en: It was a quiet, uneventful flight.
ex.zh: 那是一趟平靜無事的飛行。

ex.en: Our weekend was pleasantly uneventful.
ex.zh: 我們的週末平靜無事，這樣剛剛好。

ex.en: The blow to his head caused brief unconsciousness.
ex.zh: 頭部受到撞擊讓他短暫失去意識。

ex.en: She slipped into unconsciousness before the ambulance arrived.
ex.zh: 救護車抵達前她就失去了意識。

ex.en: The plan turned out to be unworkable.
ex.zh: 這個計畫最後證明行不通。

ex.en: Their unworkable schedule made everyone tired.
ex.zh: 他們那份行不通的時間表讓大家都很累。

ex.en: The hotel has an understated, elegant style.
ex.zh: 這家飯店有低調優雅的風格。

ex.en: Her understated humor made everyone smile.
ex.zh: 她含蓄的幽默讓大家都笑了。

ex.en: He was fined for running an unlicensed business.
ex.zh: 他因經營無照生意而被罰款。

ex.en: Unlicensed taxis are not safe for tourists.
ex.zh: 無照計程車對觀光客來說不安全。

ex.en: It was an undignified way to leave the party.
ex.zh: 那是個不體面的離開派對的方式。

ex.en: He felt undignified running after the bus in a suit.
ex.zh: 他穿著西裝追公車，覺得很失體面。

ex.en: He felt he had been unjustly treated by his boss.
ex.zh: 他覺得自己被老闆不公平地對待。

ex.en: The man was unjustly accused of stealing.
ex.zh: 那名男子被冤枉偷東西。

ex.en: You have my undivided attention.
ex.zh: 我全神貫注地聽你說。

ex.en: She gave the baby her undivided love.
ex.zh: 她把全部的愛都給了那個寶寶。

ex.en: The land stayed undivided after his death.
ex.zh: 他過世後，這塊土地仍保持完整未分割。

ex.en: They hoped for an undivided country again.
ex.zh: 他們期盼國家再次完整統一。

ex.en: He gave the plan uncritical support.
ex.zh: 他不假思索地支持這個計畫。

ex.en: An uncritical reader may believe everything online.
ex.zh: 不加思考的讀者可能會相信網路上的一切。

ex.en: The children ran in unrestrained joy across the field.
ex.zh: 孩子們在草地上盡情奔跑，開心得毫無拘束。

ex.en: He felt unrestrained anger when he heard the lie.
ex.zh: 他聽到謊言時怒不可遏。

ex.en: The champion seemed unbeatable this season.
ex.zh: 這位冠軍本季看起來無人能敵。

ex.en: This shop offers unbeatable prices on shoes.
ex.zh: 這家店的鞋子價格無人能比。

ex.en: He wore a white undershirt beneath his dress shirt.
ex.zh: 他在襯衫底下穿了一件白色汗衫。

ex.en: I bought a pack of cotton undershirts for the winter.
ex.zh: 我買了一包純棉汗衫準備過冬。

unstructured.zh: 無固定結構的；非結構化的

ex.en: The meeting was unstructured, so it wandered from topic to topic.
ex.zh: 這場會議沒有固定結構，話題東扯西扯。

ex.en: The company stores a lot of unstructured data like emails.
ex.zh: 公司儲存了許多像電子郵件這類非結構化的資料。

ex.en: The children were uninhibited and danced everywhere.
ex.zh: 孩子們毫無拘束，到處跳舞。

ex.en: She gave an uninhibited laugh at the joke.
ex.zh: 她對那個笑話毫不拘束地大笑。

unattached.zh: 單身的；沒有附屬關係的

ex.en: She is young, smart, and unattached.
ex.zh: 她年輕又聰明，還單身。

ex.en: The old shed stood unattached to the main house.
ex.zh: 那間舊棚屋與主屋是分開的。

ex.en: He had an undistinguished career as a clerk.
ex.zh: 他當了一輩子平凡無奇的職員。

ex.en: The restaurant serves undistinguished food at high prices.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳賣的是普通無奇卻價格不低的食物。

unawares.zh: 出其不意地；不知不覺地

ex.en: The sudden question caught me unawares.
ex.zh: 這個突如其來的問題讓我措手不及。

ex.en: The rain took the hikers unawares and they got soaked.
ex.zh: 這場雨來得出其不意，登山客全被淋濕了。

unfolding.zh: 展開；攤開（unfold 的現在分詞）

ex.en: She sat on the bed unfolding the map.
ex.zh: 她坐在床上攤開那張地圖。

ex.en: The child watched the paper crane slowly unfolding in the water.
ex.zh: 孩子看著紙鶴在水中慢慢展開。

ex.en: We watched the unfolding drama with great interest.
ex.zh: 我們興致勃勃地看著事情逐步發展的戲劇性經過。

ex.en: Reporters are covering the unfolding story live.
ex.zh: 記者正在現場報導這則持續發展的新聞。

ex.en: The photo came out blurry and unfocused.
ex.zh: 這張照片拍出來模糊又失焦。

ex.en: After a sleepless night, I felt tired and unfocused at work.
ex.zh: 一夜沒睡後，我上班時又累又無法專心。

unsuspected.zh: 意想不到的；未被懷疑的

ex.en: The old house hid an unsuspected room behind the wall.
ex.zh: 那棟老房子牆後藏著一間意想不到的房間。

ex.en: She had unsuspected talent as a painter.
ex.zh: 她有著沒人料到的繪畫天分。

ex.en: There was a pile of unwashed dishes in the sink.
ex.zh: 水槽裡堆著一疊沒洗的碗盤。

ex.en: Wash the fruit first, because it is still unwashed.
ex.zh: 水果還沒洗，要先洗過。

ex.en: Early cells in the embryo are undifferentiated.
ex.zh: 胚胎早期的細胞是未分化的。

ex.en: The report treated all customers as an undifferentiated group.
ex.zh: 這份報告把所有顧客當成沒有區別的同一群人。

ex.en: The thief remained unrepentant even after the trial.
ex.zh: 即使審判結束，那名小偷仍毫無悔意。

ex.en: She was an unrepentant fan of old movies.
ex.zh: 她是個毫不羞愧的老電影迷。

unreadable.zh: 難以辨認的；讀不下去的

ex.en: The doctor's handwriting is almost unreadable.
ex.zh: 那位醫生的字跡幾乎無法辨認。

ex.en: I found the long report dry and unreadable.
ex.zh: 我覺得那份長篇報告枯燥乏味，根本讀不下去。

ex.en: The room was small and unadorned, with white walls and a single bed.
ex.zh: 房間又小又簡樸，只有白牆和一張單人床。

ex.en: She preferred an unadorned dress to a fancy one.
ex.zh: 她喜歡素雅的洋裝勝過華麗的。

ex.en: He gave the unadorned truth, without any exaggeration.
ex.zh: 他說出不加修飾的實話，毫不誇大。

ex.en: The baby slept, untroubled by the noise outside.
ex.zh: 寶寶睡得很安穩，絲毫不受外面的噪音影響。

ex.en: She walked home with an untroubled mind.
ex.zh: 她心情平靜地走路回家。

ex.en: He seemed untroubled by the bad news.
ex.zh: 他似乎沒有被壞消息困擾。

ex.en: Lying to your friend like that was unforgivable.
ex.zh: 那樣對朋友說謊是不可原諒的。

ex.en: She said his rude behavior was simply unforgivable.
ex.zh: 她說他的無禮行為根本不可原諒。

ex.en: Forgetting her birthday felt like an unforgivable mistake.
ex.zh: 忘了她的生日讓我覺得是個不可原諒的錯誤。

ex.en: The customer left unsatisfied with the service.
ex.zh: 那位顧客對服務不滿意地離開了。

ex.en: She felt unsatisfied after such a small meal.
ex.zh: 吃了這麼少的一餐，她覺得還沒吃飽。

ex.en: A sample of ten people is unrepresentative of the whole country.
ex.zh: 十個人的樣本不能代表整個國家。

ex.en: That one bad review is unrepresentative of what most customers think.
ex.zh: 那則負評不能代表大多數顧客的想法。

ex.en: That is an unflattering photo of me.
ex.zh: 那是一張把我拍得很難看的照片。

ex.en: The article gave an unflattering description of the mayor.
ex.zh: 那篇文章對市長的描述並不討好。

ex.en: Many basic needs of the villagers remain unmet.
ex.zh: 村民的許多基本需求仍未得到滿足。

ex.en: The company's goals were still unmet at the end of the year.
ex.zh: 年底時，公司的目標仍未達成。

ex.en: The witness was uncooperative and refused to answer.
ex.zh: 證人不肯合作，拒絕回答。

ex.en: An uncooperative child can make a trip stressful.
ex.zh: 不聽話的孩子會讓旅行變得很累人。

ex.en: Some rare medicines are unobtainable in small towns.
ex.zh: 有些罕見藥物在小鎮上買不到。

ex.en: She wanted something that was unobtainable.
ex.zh: 她想要的是得不到的東西。

unenviable.zh: 不令人羨慕的；吃力不討好的

ex.en: He faced the unenviable task of firing his friend.
ex.zh: 他面臨開除朋友這個苦差事。

ex.en: The team is in the unenviable position of being last.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍處在墊底的尷尬處境。

ex.en: His pride was his undoing.
ex.zh: 他的驕傲是他垮台的原因。

ex.en: Greed proved to be the company's undoing.
ex.zh: 貪婪最終成了這家公司的致命傷。

ex.en: She spent an hour undoing the knots in the rope.
ex.zh: 她花了一個小時解開繩子上的結。

ex.en: He is undoing all the good work we did.
ex.zh: 他正在毀掉我們做的所有努力。

untried.zh: 未經試驗的；沒有經驗的

ex.en: The plan is bold but still untried.
ex.zh: 這個計畫很大膽，但還沒有經過試驗。

ex.en: They hired an untried manager for the new shop.
ex.zh: 他們為新店雇了一位沒有經驗的經理。

ex.en: I don't want to leave any option untried.
ex.zh: 我不想放過任何一個還沒試過的辦法。

ex.en: The waiter unobtrusively refilled our glasses.
ex.zh: 服務生不著痕跡地替我們把杯子斟滿。

ex.en: She slipped unobtrusively into the back row of the hall.
ex.zh: 她悄悄地溜進禮堂最後一排坐下。

ex.en: She is grateful for her family's unfailing support.
ex.zh: 她很感謝家人始終如一的支持。

ex.en: He greeted everyone with unfailing good humor.
ex.zh: 他總是帶著不變的幽默感跟大家打招呼。

unsung.zh: 默默無聞的；未受表揚的

ex.en: Nurses are often the unsung heroes of a hospital.
ex.zh: 護理師常是醫院裡默默付出的英雄。

ex.en: The unsung writer finally received an award.
ex.zh: 那位默默無聞的作家終於得獎了。

unmoving.zh: 一動也不動的；不為所動的

ex.en: The deer stood unmoving at the edge of the road.
ex.zh: 那隻鹿一動也不動地站在路邊。

ex.en: She stared at the unmoving clock on the wall.
ex.zh: 她盯著牆上停住不動的時鐘。

unspoiled.zh: 未受破壞的；保持原貌的

ex.en: The island still has unspoiled beaches.
ex.zh: 這座島上仍有未受破壞的海灘。

ex.en: We hiked through unspoiled forest for two days.
ex.zh: 我們在未遭破壞的森林裡健行了兩天。

ex.en: A strange sense of unreality came over her after the news.
ex.zh: 聽到那個消息後，她心頭湧上一股奇異的不真實感。

ex.en: The fog gave the street an air of unreality.
ex.zh: 霧讓這條街道帶著一種虛幻的氣氛。

unguarded.zh: 無人看守的；毫無防備的

ex.en: The back door was left unguarded all night.
ex.zh: 後門整晚沒人看守。

ex.en: In an unguarded moment, he told her the secret.
ex.zh: 他在一時不經意間把祕密告訴了她。

unacknowledged.zh: 未被承認的；未被認可的

ex.en: His hard work went unacknowledged by the boss.
ex.zh: 他的努力沒有得到老闆的認可。

ex.en: The email remained unacknowledged for a week.
ex.zh: 那封電子郵件一週都沒有人回覆。

ex.en: It's an undemanding job with plenty of free time.
ex.zh: 這是份要求不高又有很多空閒時間的工作。

ex.en: She is a calm, undemanding guest who needs very little.
ex.zh: 她是個隨和不挑剔的客人，幾乎沒什麼需求。

ex.en: The artist began with a thin brown underpainting.
ex.zh: 畫家先以一層薄薄的棕色打底。

ex.en: You can sometimes see the underpainting through the top layers of color.
ex.zh: 有時你能透過上層顏料看見底層的畫底。

ex.en: It was an unthinking remark and she regretted it at once.
ex.zh: 那是一句不經思考的話，她馬上就後悔了。

ex.en: He gave an unthinking nod without reading the contract.
ex.zh: 他連合約都沒看就不假思索地點了頭。

ex.en: The technical manual is hard for the uninitiated to understand.
ex.zh: 這份技術手冊對外行人來說很難懂。

ex.en: To the uninitiated, the game's rules seem very confusing.
ex.zh: 對沒接觸過的人來說，這個遊戲的規則看起來很混亂。

ex.en: Some say the future is unknowable.
ex.zh: 有人說未來是無法預知的。

ex.en: The exact cause of the fire remains unknowable.
ex.zh: 這場火災的確切原因依舊無從得知。

unsophisticated.zh: 單純的；不世故的；簡陋的

ex.en: He was an unsophisticated young man from a small town.
ex.zh: 他是來自小鎮、單純不世故的年輕人。

ex.en: The tools they used were simple and unsophisticated.
ex.zh: 他們使用的工具既簡單又粗糙。

unobserved.zh: 沒被注意到的；未被察覺的

ex.en: She slipped out of the room unobserved.
ex.zh: 她沒被人發現地溜出了房間。

ex.en: The small change went unobserved for several years.
ex.zh: 這個小變化好幾年都沒人注意到。

unencumbered.zh: 不受阻礙的；沒有負擔的

ex.en: She traveled light and unencumbered by heavy bags.
ex.zh: 她輕裝上路，不用拖著沉重的行李。

ex.en: He wanted a house unencumbered by debt.
ex.zh: 他想要一棟沒有負債的房子。

ex.en: We walked along an unlit road in the dark.
ex.zh: 我們在黑暗中走過一條沒有路燈的路。

ex.en: The candles on the cake were still unlit.
ex.zh: 蛋糕上的蠟燭還沒點燃。

ex.en: She ran unopposed in the class election and won easily.
ex.zh: 她在班級選舉中沒有對手，輕鬆獲勝。

ex.en: The plan passed unopposed at the meeting.
ex.zh: 這項計畫在會議中無人反對地通過了。

ex.en: She felt unaccountably sad on a sunny day.
ex.zh: 在陽光明媚的日子裡，她莫名地感到難過。

ex.en: The train was unaccountably late this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上火車不知為何晚點了。

ex.en: It is unseemly to laugh at a funeral.
ex.zh: 在葬禮上大笑是不得體的。

ex.en: They left the party after an unseemly argument.
ex.zh: 一場不得體的爭吵之後，他們離開了派對。

ex.en: He remained unperturbed by the loud noise.
ex.zh: 他對巨大的噪音依然不為所動。

ex.en: She stayed unperturbed even when the plan failed.
ex.zh: 即使計畫失敗，她仍然很鎮定。

ex.en: Never drink unclean water from a stream without boiling it.
ex.zh: 千萬別不經煮沸就喝溪裡不乾淨的水。

ex.en: The kitchen was unclean, so the inspector closed the restaurant.
ex.zh: 廚房不衛生，所以稽查員讓餐廳停業。

ex.en: The puppy looked thin and unloved in the shelter.
ex.zh: 那隻小狗在收容所裡看起來又瘦又沒人疼。

ex.en: No child should ever feel unloved at home.
ex.zh: 沒有孩子應該在家裡覺得不被愛。

ex.en: His uncouth behavior at dinner embarrassed his parents.
ex.zh: 他在晚餐時的粗魯舉止讓父母很難堪。

ex.en: The uncouth guest spoke loudly with food in his mouth.
ex.zh: 那位沒教養的客人嘴裡塞著食物還大聲說話。

unanswerable.zh: 無法回答的；無可反駁的

ex.en: Some questions about the universe seem unanswerable.
ex.zh: 有些關於宇宙的問題似乎無法回答。

ex.en: She made an unanswerable argument, and nobody could disagree.
ex.zh: 她提出了無可反駁的論點，沒人能反對。

ex.en: She stayed unruffled even when the meeting went badly.
ex.zh: 就算會議進行得很糟，她仍然沉著鎮定。

ex.en: The pilot remained unruffled during the storm.
ex.zh: 飛行員在暴風雨中依然保持冷靜。

ex.en: This is an underrated movie that deserves more attention.
ex.zh: 這是一部被低估的電影，值得更多關注。

ex.en: He is an underrated player who rarely gets credit.
ex.zh: 他是個被低估的球員，很少得到讚譽。

ex.en: I underrated how difficult the exam would be.
ex.zh: 我低估了這場考試的難度。

ex.en: They underrated their opponents and lost the game.
ex.zh: 他們低估了對手，結果輸了比賽。

ex.en: They enjoyed an unhurried breakfast on the balcony.
ex.zh: 他們在陽台上悠閒地吃了早餐。

ex.en: She spoke in a calm, unhurried voice.
ex.zh: 她用平靜從容的聲音說話。

ex.en: Many doctors say that this diet is unscientific and unsafe.
ex.zh: 許多醫生說這種飲食法不科學，也不安全。

ex.en: His unscientific method made the results impossible to trust.
ex.zh: 他不科學的方法讓結果無法令人信任。

ex.en: It is unscientific to decide anything without checking the facts.
ex.zh: 沒有查證事實就下結論是不科學的。

ex.en: The baby giraffe took a few ungainly steps on its long legs.
ex.zh: 小長頸鹿用牠細長的腿笨拙地走了幾步。

ex.en: He felt ungainly in his oversized coat.
ex.zh: 他穿著那件過大的外套，覺得自己的樣子很笨拙。

ex.en: The ungainly old truck made a loud noise as it climbed the hill.
ex.zh: 那輛笨重難看的舊卡車爬坡時發出很大的聲響。

ex.en: The charity offers free lunches to underprivileged children.
ex.zh: 這個慈善機構為弱勢兒童提供免費午餐。

ex.en: He grew up in an underprivileged neighborhood with few services.
ex.zh: 他在一個資源匱乏的弱勢社區長大。

ex.en: Volunteers tutor underprivileged students every weekend.
ex.zh: 志工每個週末為弱勢學生課後輔導。

ex.en: The cause of the fire is still undetermined.
ex.zh: 起火原因仍未確定。

ex.en: The meeting will take place at an undetermined time next week.
ex.zh: 會議將在下週某個尚未確定的時間舉行。

ex.en: The speech was long and uninspiring.
ex.zh: 那場演講又長又乏味，毫無啟發。

ex.en: We ate an uninspiring meal at the airport.
ex.zh: 我們在機場吃了一頓平淡無奇的餐。

ex.en: He found the job uninspiring and soon quit.
ex.zh: 他覺得這份工作毫無吸引力，很快就辭職了。

ex.en: The runners passed unhindered through the open gate.
ex.zh: 跑者們毫無阻礙地穿過敞開的大門。

ex.en: Scientists want unhindered access to the data.
ex.zh: 科學家希望能不受限制地取得這些資料。

ex.en: Her enthusiasm for the project remained undiminished.
ex.zh: 她對這個專案的熱情絲毫未減。

ex.en: The band's popularity is undiminished after twenty years.
ex.zh: 這個樂團的人氣在二十年後依然不減。

unacceptably.zh: 無法接受地；令人無法容忍地

ex.en: The noise from the road was unacceptably loud.
ex.zh: 路上的噪音大到令人無法接受。

ex.en: The service was unacceptably slow, so we left.
ex.zh: 服務慢到令人無法忍受，所以我們離開了。

ex.en: He unwisely spent all his savings on one risky plan.
ex.zh: 他不明智地把所有積蓄都花在一個冒險的計畫上。

ex.en: They unwisely ignored the weather warning and went hiking.
ex.zh: 他們不明智地無視天氣警報去健行。

unpaved.zh: 未鋪柏油的；沒鋪路面的

ex.en: We drove along an unpaved road to the village.
ex.zh: 我們沿著一條未鋪設的路開往村子。

ex.en: The unpaved paths turn muddy after heavy rain.
ex.zh: 這些未鋪設的小路在大雨後會變得泥濘。

unmanageable.zh: 難以管理的；難以控制的

ex.en: My workload has become unmanageable this month.
ex.zh: 我這個月的工作量已經多到難以負荷。

ex.en: The class grew so large that it was unmanageable.
ex.zh: 這個班級變得太大，已經難以管理。

ex.en: The undisciplined team kept missing its deadlines.
ex.zh: 這個散漫的團隊一再錯過截止期限。

ex.en: He is talented but undisciplined in his daily habits.
ex.zh: 他很有才華，但日常習慣缺乏自律。

ex.en: Don't accept everything you read online uncritically.
ex.zh: 不要不加思索地接受你在網路上讀到的一切。

ex.en: He uncritically repeated what the salesman had told him.
ex.zh: 他毫不質疑地重複了業務員對他說的話。

ex.en: It is illegal for a company to underpay its workers.
ex.zh: 公司少付員工薪水是違法的。

ex.en: The owner was caught trying to underpay the delivery drivers.
ex.zh: 老闆被抓到想少付外送司機薪資。

ex.en: He was unceremoniously dropped from the team.
ex.zh: 他被毫不客氣地從隊上除名。

ex.en: The old sofa was unceremoniously thrown out of the window.
ex.zh: 那張舊沙發被粗魯地從窗戶丟了出去。

ex.en: The driver walked away from the crash unhurt.
ex.zh: 駕駛從車禍中毫髮無傷地走了出來。

ex.en: Everyone in the building was unhurt after the small fire.
ex.zh: 那場小火災後，大樓裡的每個人都平安無事。

ex.en: Thankfully, the children were unhurt when the bus stopped suddenly.
ex.zh: 幸好公車突然停下時，孩子們都沒有受傷。

ex.en: It was unprofessional of him to shout at a customer.
ex.zh: 他對顧客大吼大叫很不專業。

ex.en: The unprofessional behavior of the staff upset many guests.
ex.zh: 員工不專業的舉止讓許多客人不滿。

ex.en: Wearing a messy T-shirt to the meeting looked unprofessional.
ex.zh: 穿著凌亂的 T 恤去開會看起來不專業。

ex.en: He has an unshakeable belief in the team.
ex.zh: 他對這支團隊有著堅定不移的信念。

ex.en: Their friendship is unshakeable after all these years.
ex.zh: 這麼多年來，他們的友誼始終堅定不移。

ex.en: The uncut fruit was still in the basket.
ex.zh: 沒切的水果還在籃子裡。

ex.en: We watched the uncut version of the film.
ex.zh: 我們看了這部電影的未刪節版。

ex.en: Too much weight on one side can unbalance the boat.
ex.zh: 一邊負重太多會讓船失去平衡。

ex.en: The sudden bad news may unbalance his mind.
ex.zh: 突如其來的壞消息可能讓他情緒失衡。

ex.en: It was an unselfish act to give up her seat for the old man.
ex.zh: 把座位讓給老先生是一個無私的舉動。

ex.en: He is an unselfish teammate who always passes the ball.
ex.zh: 他是個無私的隊友，總是把球傳出去。

ex.en: The cat rolled over and showed its soft underbelly.
ex.zh: 那隻貓翻過身，露出柔軟的肚子。

ex.en: The plane's underbelly was covered in mud.
ex.zh: 飛機的機腹沾滿了泥巴。

ex.en: The film shows the dark underbelly of the big city.
ex.zh: 這部電影呈現了大城市的陰暗面。

ex.en: Critics pointed to the weak underbelly of the plan.
ex.zh: 評論者指出了這個計畫的薄弱處。

ex.en: The weather was uncommonly warm for December.
ex.zh: 就十二月而言，天氣異常溫暖。

ex.en: She is uncommonly kind to strangers.
ex.zh: 她對陌生人格外和善。

ex.en: She likes an uncluttered desk when she studies.
ex.zh: 她讀書時喜歡桌面保持整齊。

ex.en: The uncluttered design makes the website easy to use.
ex.zh: 簡潔不雜亂的設計讓這個網站很好用。

unobstructed.zh: 沒有阻礙的；視野開闊的

ex.en: The hotel room has an unobstructed view of the sea.
ex.zh: 這間飯店房間可以毫無遮擋地看到海景。

ex.en: Keep the exit unobstructed at all times.
ex.zh: 出口處隨時都要保持暢通。

ex.en: The new rule was uncontroversial and passed quickly.
ex.zh: 這項新規定沒有爭議，很快就通過了。

ex.en: Choosing a lunch spot is rarely uncontroversial in our office.
ex.zh: 在我們辦公室，選午餐地點很少是沒有爭議的事。

ex.en: He felt an unaccountable fear in the empty house.
ex.zh: 他在空屋裡感到一股莫名的恐懼。

ex.en: There was an unaccountable delay at the airport.
ex.zh: 機場出現了無法解釋的延誤。

ex.en: I'm feeling a bit under the weather, so I'll stay home today.
ex.zh: 我覺得有點不舒服，所以今天待在家裡。

ex.en: She looked under the weather after the long flight.
ex.zh: 經過長途飛行後，她看起來不太舒服。

ex.en: He's been under the weather all week and needs some rest.
ex.zh: 他整個星期都不太舒服，需要休息一下。

under the weather.en: feeling slightly ill or a little sad

ex.en: The firefighters soon had the fire under control.
ex.zh: 消防員很快就把火勢控制住了。

ex.en: Don't worry, everything is under control.
ex.zh: 別擔心，一切都在掌控中。

under control.en: being managed so that it is not dangerous

ex.en: He felt under pressure to win the contest.
ex.zh: 他覺得有贏得比賽的壓力。

ex.en: Some people work better under pressure.
ex.zh: 有些人在壓力下工作表現更好。

under pressure.en: feeling worried because people expect a lot from you

ex.en: The new bridge is still under construction.
ex.zh: 那座新橋還在興建中。

ex.en: Our road is under construction, so traffic is slow.
ex.zh: 我們這條路正在施工，所以車流很慢。
